news.title: Price target increased by 8.0% to ₹3,846
news.body: Up from ₹3,560, the current price target is an average from 19 analysts. New target price is 12% above last closing price of ₹3,429. Stock is up 32% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹58.90 for next year compared to ₹45.16 last year.

news.title: Dividend increased to ₹9.00
news.body: Dividend of ₹9.00 is 125% higher than last year. Ex-date: 24th July 2026 Payment date: 6th September 2026 Dividend yield will be 0.3%, which is about the same as the industry average. Payout Ratios Payout ratio: 15%. Cash payout ratio: 11%.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹45.16 (up from ₹25.84 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹209.9b (up 333% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹6.04b (up 75% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 2.9% (down from 7.1% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) surpassed analyst estimates by 6.4%. Revenue is expected to decline by 30% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, while revenues in the Beverage industry in India are expected to grow by 8.3%. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 34% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 45% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹11.57 (vs ₹7.14 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹11.57 (up from ₹7.14 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹15.5b (up 20% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.55b (up 62% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 10.0% (up from 7.4% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 13% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 12% growth forecast for the Beverage industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 29% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 41% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
